design_decisions: Vanilla ADU, GRA, and ALG were not reused because they represent Andalusia, Granada, and Algiers rather than a southern Portuguese Algarve/Gharb rival.
AGH was free in vanilla country_tags and Project Crown country_tags at implementation time.
Primary culture is portugese to keep the state a Portuguese mirror first, not a North African transplant.
Only the southern Portuguese block was converted to Sunni; Lisboa and northern Portugal remain Catholic under Portugal.
Portugal receives regular claims, not cores, on the southern rival block.
Al-Gharb receives a single regular claim on Lisboa and no claims on northern Portugal.
